params.name: limit

params.name: page

params.name: search
params.description: Search tap destinations by name.

params.name: destinationType
params.description: Filter tap destinations by type.

params.name: includeArchived

params.name: destinationId
params.description: The ID of the tap destination.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of tap devices to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the tap devices to return.

params.name: search
params.description: Search by exact serial number. Must be a numeric value.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Filter tap devices by group Id. Use "unassigned" to get devices not assigned to any group.

params.name: deviceType
params.description: Filter tap devices by device type.

params.name: includeArchived
params.description: Whether to include tap devices that have been archived.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the tap devices by.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction to sort the tap devices by.

items.docs: Returns tap devices for a nonprofit based on the provided filters. The search parameter matches by exact serial number, not fuzzy text search.

params.name: deviceId
params.description: The ID of the tap device.

items.docs: Returns a single tap device by ID.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of tap events to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the tap events to return.

params.name: groupIds
params.description: Filter tap events by group IDs.

params.name: destinationIds
params.description: Filter tap events by destination IDs.

params.name: deviceIds
params.description: Filter tap events by device IDs.

params.name: startDate
params.description: Filter tap events on or after this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: endDate
params.description: Filter tap events on or before this date (ISO 8601).

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction to sort the tap events by. Events are always sorted by time of occurrence.

items.docs: Returns tap events for a nonprofit based on the provided filters. Events represent individual tap interactions and are sorted by time of occurrence.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of tap groups to return.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number of the tap groups to return.

params.name: search
params.description: Search tap groups by name.

params.name: includeArchived
params.description: Whether to include tap groups that have been archived.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort the tap groups by.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: The direction to sort the tap groups by.

items.docs: Returns tap groups for a nonprofit based on the provided filters.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the tap group.

items.docs: Returns a single tap group by ID.
